name: Calendesk
description: B2B booking + payments + client portal for therapists, psychologists, coaches, lawyers, beauty/fitness — white-label, subscription packages, API-first. Polish-founded, bootstrapped since 2020.

mentions.evidence: ~$21.5k MRR, 376 active subscriptions, ~$37.0k L30, ~$1.13M all-time, founded May 2020, Poland. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Country/vertical booking for regulated service pros (therapy, legal, tutoring) still underserved vs Calendly-generic.

whyItPrints: Service pros already schedule and take deposits every day. Calendesk owns that workflow at ~$79–$147/mo instead of inventing a new category.
whyThisMatters:
Therapists, coaches, psychologists, lawyers, and beauty or fitness businesses sell time. Calendesk keeps the calendar, the payment, the reminder, and the booking site in one login. A client picks a slot and pays. It still works late on a Saturday. Nobody has to call.

A client can buy ten sessions at once, or a membership that bills every month. Stripe collects on your schedule, so you're not chasing invoices. You can also charge per visit, and you can put your own brand on it. A REST API can hand open slots, bookings, and payments to software you already run.

The booking page sits on your domain. You drag the blocks around. A QR code on a card or a flyer points people at it. The form can ask your questions, such as allergies or which therapist they want. When someone books, your phone shows the name, the time, and the service, and you can tap to call. Zoom, Google Meet, WhatsApp, and Zapier connect. An open-source hook works with ChatGPT and Claude, so "book Anna for Friday at 2" can become the appointment. It started in Poland in 2020, still bootstrapped. More than a million meetings have gone through it.
